metric_choice.reason: Both are explicit realized F02 inputs. Every issuer uses the same two metrics, consolidated basis, direct three-month current and prior-year same-quarter columns. No operating margin, net income, backlog or utilization proxy is substituted.

period_heterogeneity.reason: The F02 schema requires the appropriate prior comparable period for each realized metric; it does not prescribe an identical fiscal quarter across all issuers. D1 explicitly chooses the latest confirmed cutoff-safe realized quarter in the bounded source set, with Q2 preferred and Q1 fallback. Each observed pair is internally same-quarter, same-basis and three months, and enters the same W1 eligible snapshot. The resulting common object is latest supported year-over-year realized change, not a common-quarter cross-section.

unit_and_operator.reason: RELATIVE change is dimensionless. Multiplying both values in one pair by the same positive exact unit scale cancels algebraically. Raw KRW new-issuer pairs may therefore coexist with raw KRW_MILLION control pairs. Both values within each pair must have the same unit, currency, accounting basis and period length. Preserve raw signed Decimal strings; no rounding or binary float conversion is needed.
unit_and_operator.reporting_rule: Revenue may be reported as YoY percent. For negative-prior operating profit label the percentage as signed change relative to absolute prior and explicitly disclose turnaround; do not imply a conventional positive-base profit growth rate.

issuer_dispositions.meaning: Revenue declines and operating profit changes from profit to loss. The unchanged signed RELATIVE operator produces negative changes; parentheses must parse as negative current operating profit.

Use the comparative amount actually displayed in the cutoff-safe 2024 Q1 consolidated statement. The same source discloses discontinued-operation reclassification and the adjustment from -448,371,497 to -442,977,057 KRW. This is historical restatement knowledge available by W1, not future restatement knowledge. Revenue is unchanged by the disclosed reclassification. The negative prior denominator is nonzero; the existing abs(prior) formula measures the improvement from loss to profit without reversing its sign.

required_implementation_conditions.condition: Materialize exactly revenue and operating_profit current, prior, change_mode=RELATIVE and the bound operator_id for each admitted issuer. Keep all other features, weights, scorer and eligibility states unchanged.

Bind every consumed numeric leaf to the preserved source hash, issuer, publication bound, consolidated table, same-quarter current/prior three-month column, row label, unit and exact raw cell. Bind mode/operator leaves to the approved derivation policy and implementation lineage.

Retain raw signed Decimal strings in each source's native unit; if exact scaling is used, record it for both values and prove the dimensionless relative result is invariant. Do not round, strip signs, use half-year subtraction or substitute a metric.
Carry per-issuer reporting periods, Q1 fallback bounded evidence, 025560 prior restatement/turnaround and 005290 provisional source status into FEATURE_SIDECAR and the completion report.
Run the existing unchanged engine against the governed full W1 snapshot after validation gates permit; preserve 127/57/8/62 denominators and all previous PC1/score/seal artifacts.

required_p4_validation_conditions.condition: Independent source-to-leaf readback confirms all 20 observed numeric cells, ten same-unit/same-metric/same-basis/same-quarter pairs, publication bounds and source byte hashes, including raw locator rebinding for worker B sources.

Affected tests prove negative-current deterioration, negative-prior turnaround, prior-zero rejection, wrong period/basis/unit/issuer/hash/column rejection and raw-unit relative scale invariance without modifying model arithmetic.

Exact-target preservation evidence confirms unchanged model/schema/features/scorer/weight config, missingness behavior, eligibility denominator and future-outcome firewall; tests alone do not establish preservation.

Paired domain review and required independent audit must disposition the materialized policy/adapter/input/sidecar bundle before P5 scoring. This author classification is not their validation receipt.

Verify F02 per-metric percentile/median traces and output coverage using the unchanged engine, label all ranks observed-cohort provisional, and prevent official Top3/Top10 or full-universe scientific performance claims despite any engine-generated flags.

If control validation cannot establish publication/provenance or contract fit for a candidate, remove it from admitted input without imputation and re-evaluate whether the remaining validated cohort satisfies the permitted P5/terminal requirements.
